note: On Lake Tahoe's west shore two miles south of Tahoe City, under tall pine and fir beside Highway 89 in a residential area; the lake and a day-use beach are across the highway. Ten sites take only pickup campers or tents, so check the site's own length. Run by a concessionaire. --Claude
summary: William Kent: seasonal (late May to mid-October), rec.gov $42 (+$2 holidays), 76 sites + 3 yurts, no hookups, flush toilets, water per rec.gov; 58 of 76 take 24 ft+. Not waterfront (lake across Hwy 89) confirmed. Pin 224 m to the site centroid (under 250 m). Phone empty -> 530-583-3642; website recarea link -> r05 page.
